title: Mob Inspector
description: Adds Mob Inspector that allows you to look at any creature's inventory, hands and armor slots and change its content.
body:
Adds Mob Inspector that allows you to look at any creature's inventory, hands and armor slots and change its content. 
Mob Inspector can be taken and used only in Creative Mode or if player has cheat commands enabled.

Right Click with Mob Inspector on any creature to open its inventory, place or remove items, you can give diamond sword to Zombie that way f.e.
